channel.title: Songs of Praise
channel.desc: Aled Jones meets `Songs of Praise' conductor Ken Burton to discuss why, in times of difficulty and trouble, the singing of Christian hymns can lift hearts and soothe souls. Plus, revisit Sean Fletcher's meeting with Graham Kendrick, who talked about writing his generation-defining song `Shine Jesus Shine' in the 1980s. Aled also recalls Pam Rhodes's meeting with Catholic hymn writer Bernadette Farrell.
